reviewStandard: Each of the six frozen routes received exactly one built-in generation call. All six originals were preserved and inspected independently at native 1536 by 1024 resolution. Literal output, exact body and group counts, geometry, prohibited content, outer 32-pixel field, crop bounds, hashes, and conservative meaning controlled disposition; prompt intent was never treated as observation. Reviewer disagreements on sphere identity, intestinal specificity, and overlapping microbial bodies were resolved conservatively against publication.
promotionRule: Only the exact accepted gingipains source hash may be promoted to a metadata-bearing lossless master, article WebP, and centered contain-mode 1200 by 630 social WebP. The Glyoxalase I, Gut Barrier Dysfunction, Gut Microbiome, Gut-Brain Axis, and Gut-Gonadal Axis originals remain immutable non-public quarantines.

assets.scientificFinding: Gingipains are cysteine endopeptidases rather than zinc-dependent metalloproteases. RgpB and Kgp resolved fragments can orient the Arg- and Lys-specific classes without representing full-length RgpA, metal dependence, a catalytic event, virulence, or disease causality.
assets.visualReview: Exactly two separated protein-fragment assemblies are present; each is one continuous two-domain body with one visibly empty recessed cleft.

outputAudit.reviewedBy: WikiBiome Control Tower multi-reviewer native-resolution visual audit
outputAudit.observedSubjectDescription: Two widely separated related but nonidentical assemblies each contain one joined primary body articulated as two differently colored connected domain masses with one empty recessed cleft.

assets.quarantineReason: One sphere is warm copper or bronze and the other is slate-violet rather than two identical matte nickel-context spheres; neither clearly occupies a shared subunit-interface context.
